The committee's recommendations will be tabled in Lok Sabha soon.

title: 'Asked mom for Rs 6,000': Mystery shrouds Hyderabad student's death in Finland
description: Finnish authorities officially declared Manideep Reddy Gujja dead after his disappearance in May. An unidentified body recovered from the sea was identified through fingerprint analysis. The recovered wallet contained Manideep's identity card and his mother's credit card. Finnish police found no evidence of criminal activity in the case. The family has requested an independent investigation into the circumstances.

An investigation into the deaths is currently underway by local authorities.

How a New York construction scare exposed the challenges of converting offices into homes
description: A New York City office conversion project faced a setback after steel columns buckled. This incident underscores the significant engineering challenges in repurposing older buildings for housing. Cities are increasingly pursuing these conversions to address housing shortages and underutilized office spaces. Experts suggest this event may lead to stricter reviews for similar adaptive reuse projects. However, the strategy remains vital for sustainable urban development and addressing housing needs.
